name: Key basic checklist (any design)
about: Key's own short checklist, written for Key and not taken from any published instrument. Use it for a quick, transparent appraisal, or as a starting point for your own tool; for a Cochrane-style review use the tool your protocol names.
licence: Written for Key; MIT, like Key.

domains.name: Groups compared
domains.prompt: Whether the people compared differ only in what the study is about.

questions.text: Is it clear how each person ended up in their group?
Apart from what is being studied, do the groups look much the same?

domains.name: Measurement
domains.prompt: Whether everyone was measured in the same, trustworthy way.

questions.text: Was this result measured the same way in every group?
Could the people measuring it have been swayed by knowing who was in which group?

domains.name: Completeness
domains.prompt: Whether the result covers the people it should.

questions.text: Does the result include nearly everyone who took part?

domains.name: Reporting
domains.prompt: Whether what is reported is what the study meant to report.

questions.text: Does this result match what the study said beforehand it would measure?

domains.name: Anything else
domains.prompt: Funding, early stopping, an unusual analysis or anything else that worries you.

questions.text: Is there another reason to doubt this result?

overall.note: Suggested as the least favourable domain.
